reference_library.selection: Match the assigned argument purpose and actual role; read one or two relevant pattern files only when useful.

restricted_skills.nature-citation: Only when the user explicitly requests Nature/CNS-only source scope; never the default MCM literature search.
restricted_skills.nature-data: Only for explicitly assigned Data/Code Availability or repository planning, not data cleaning; publication requires its own authorization.
restricted_skills.venue-templates: Do not replace the established MCM template with a journal template.

mcm-model-lead.limits: No new model or experiment without a scoped contract; ordinary modeling tasks need no forced skill.

mcm-modeler.limits: Preserve the blind phase and declared scope; do not import a full modeling orchestrator.

mcm-evidence.limits: Use unrestricted subject-appropriate sources; no automatic citation-impact or timed literature pipeline.
Correct DOI/metadata does not prove that the source supports the manuscript claim.
Report actual reading scope; never invent full-text access.

mcm-programmer.limits: Ordinary code solving uses the approved formula/code contract; independent verification remains outside the author branch.

mcm-verifier.branch: units, independence, uncertainty and test validity
mcm-verifier.limits: No new analysis without explicit data/task; distinguish reproduction from scientific validity.
Review original support as well as bibliographic fields.

mcm-paper-lead.limits: Keep the user seven-part framework and MCM rules; no Nature submission package or replacement outline.
Preserve numbers, symbols, citations and conclusion strength; scientific changes return upstream.

mcm-writer.limits: Write only task-owned drafts under the user framework; do not edit the integrated manuscript.
Do not strengthen evidence or change model/results.

mcm-figure.limits: Fixed result inputs and figure contract; final-size 12pt core labels; new estimators/tests/filters return upstream.
Default 1–2 framework/method schematics for the whole paper; no invented measurements or generative result plots.

mcm-typesetter.limits: Compile through the verified project LaTeX entry; pdf is not a complete TeX compiler or a scientific validator.

mcm-reviewer.limits: Score by MCM problem/rules and internal rubric, not Nature novelty or editorial acceptance criteria.
